units.source_text: 我沒有回答，夾起一小條幹沙丁魚，看著小魚的銀色眼珠，

en.t: I did not answer, but picked up a little strip of dried sardine and stared at the tiny fish's silvery eyes,

units.source_text: 酒勁上頭，油然懷念起以前四處遊玩的時光，甚至包括堀木，

en.t: as the drink went to my head, I found myself fondly remembering the days when I used to wander about, even Horiki included,

units.source_text: 我深深地渴望「自由」，突然間，脆弱得差一點哭出聲。

en.t: I longed deeply for freedom, and all at once grew so fragile that I nearly cried aloud.

units.source_text: 自從搬進這個家後，我連搞笑的慾望都沒了，

en.t: Ever since moving into this house, I had lost even the desire to play the clown,

units.source_text: 每天在比目魚和小夥子的蔑視中橫臥在床，

en.t: lying in bed every day under the contempt of Flatfish and the boy,

units.source_text: 比目魚也不打算與我促膝長談，

en.t: and Flatfish had no intention of sitting down for a close, lengthy talk with me,

units.source_text: 我也無心追著他傾訴什麼，完全變成了一個傻呆呆的食客。

en.t: nor did I have the heart to chase after him and confide anything, and I had become nothing more than a blank-faced dependent at his table.

units.source_text: 「所謂的緩期起訴，是不會留下什麼前科記錄的。

en.t: A so-called suspension of prosecution does not leave you with any real criminal record.

units.source_text: 所以，只要你下定決心痛改前非，一定會獲得新生。

en.t: So, as long as you firmly resolve to mend your ways, you can certainly make a fresh start.
